_meta.description: ILM for agent-captains-funnel-events-* (monthly index agent-captains-funnel-events-YYYY-MM; ADR-0105 D6 self-improvement funnel events, e.g. throttled_budget). min_age-based delete from origination date (no rollover write-alias). Retention: 123d (owner rule 2026-10-03: a monthly index keeps the current month plus 3 full months; the longest 4-month run is 123 days; was 90d) — no prior precedent, owner-approved 2026-07-31 (FRE-1036) as the operational-diagnostics default (matches agent-monitors-slm-health-policy's category). warm forcemerge fires at 32d, matching the user-turn-ratings-policy precedent so the current monthly index isn't merged while still open. Authored in FRE-1036; this family previously had no ILM policy (0 live indices at authoring time — rare event, gated on the ADR-0040 budget-breach threshold).
